2609.31298.title: UniAR: A Unified Framework for Autism Recognition Enhanced by Multi-View Prompt Learning
2609.31298.paper_summary: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is a complex neurodevelopmental disorder for which early and accurate diagnosis is critical to improving long-term developmental outcomes. However, existing ASD recognition methods are often constrained by the scarcity of diagnostic text data, forcing them to rely mainly on visual analysis and limiting their ability to model clinically meaningful semantic reasoning. To address this challenge, we propose UniAR, a unified framework enhanced by multi-granularity prompt learning for robust ASD recognition under heterogeneous data variations. Specifically, UniAR leverages a large multimodal model to generate hierarchical diagnostic descriptions at the word, phrase, and sentence levels, compensating for the lack of paired clinical reports. To align the generated semantics with visual evidence, we further design a Mixture-of-Experts-based Multi-Scale Alignment Module, which dynamically matches vector-quantized visual prototypes with semantic representations at corresponding granularities. Extensive experiments on four benchmarks covering brain MRI and facial expression scenarios show that UniAR consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods, achieving average accuracies of 75.9\% on MRI benchmarks and 91.6\% on facial benchmarks, while improving average Accuracy on MRI benchmarks by 1.5 percentage points and average Accuracy on facial benchmarks by 1.2 percentage points over baselines. These results demonstrate that UniAR offers a robust and interpretable framework for ASD screening under semantic scarcity.
2609.31298.paper_summary_zh: 自閉症譜系障礙（ASD）是一種複雜的神經發展障礙，早期和準確的診斷對於改善長期發展結果至關重要。<lb/>然而，現有的ASD識別方法常常受到診斷文本數據稀缺的限制，迫使它們主要依賴視覺分析，限制了其建模臨床意義的語義推理的能力。<lb/>為了解決這一挑戰，我們提出了UniAR，一個通過多粒度提示學習增強的統一框架，以實現對異質數據變化下的穩健ASD識別。<lb/>具體而言，UniAR利用一個大型多模態模型生成在單詞、短語和句子層級的分層診斷描述，以彌補配對臨床報告的缺乏。<lb/>為了將生成的語義與視覺證據對齊，我們進一步設計了一個基於專家混合的多尺度對齊模塊，該模塊動態匹配向量量化的視覺原型與對應粒度的語義表示。<lb/>在涵蓋腦部MRI和面部表情場景的四個基準上進行的廣泛實驗表明，UniAR始終超越現有的最先進方法，在MRI基準上實現了75.9\%的平均準確率，在面部基準上實現了91.6\%的平均準確率，同時在MRI基準上提高了1.5個百分點的平均準確率，在面部基準上提高了1.2個百分點的平均準確率。<lb/>這些結果表明，UniAR為在語義稀缺下的ASD篩查提供了一個穩健且可解釋的框架。
